proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: s^{-1}(W) is quasi-compact open in R; its image under the continuous t is quasi-compact, and by flatness of t it is closed under generalization (03HV, 0065); choosing a quasi-compact open W' containing it, W' is spectral (094L, using U quasi-separated), and the spectral-space lemma (0A31) expresses the pro-construct... the generalization-closed quasi-compact subset as an intersection of quasi-compact opens of W' (source lines 3847-3861)
